elements.element: Customer owns all deliverables created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause grants Client only a licence to deliverables; it does not vest ownership in Client.

elements.element: Customer owns all work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause grants Client only a licence to work product; it does not vest ownership in Client.

elements.element: Vendor assigns its rights in the deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: No assignment by TrueLink to Client is included.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing IP.
elements.evidence: TrueLink retains rights in the Interface, but the clause does not identify the Interface as pre-existing IP or generally reserve TrueLink's pre-existing IP.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence to any Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The licence covers deliverables and work product but does not expressly extend to separately owned Vendor IP embedded in them.

elements.element: The licence to Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Although the deliverables licence is perpetual, no licence expressly covering embedded Vendor IP is granted.

elements.element: The licence to Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Although the deliverables licence is irrevocable, no licence expressly covering embedded Vendor IP is granted.

elements.element: The licence to Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Although the deliverables licence is royalty-free, no licence expressly covering embedded Vendor IP is granted.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Credit Data licence is narrowed to service processing, but the clause does not state that Client retains all ownership and other rights in Customer Data or Credit Data.

elements.element: The parties have no joint ownership of deliverables, work product, Vendor IP, or Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no express exclusion of joint ownership, and ownership of deliverables and work product is not allocated.

elements.element: Vendor owns its generic tools.
elements.evidence: TrueLink retains rights in the Interface, but the Interface is not identified as encompassing TrueLink's generic tools.

elements.element: Vendor owns its know-how.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause does not allocate ownership of TrueLink's know-how.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence to all deliverables.
elements.evidence: TrueLink grants Client a licence to “all deliverables and work product prepared for Client under this Agreement.”

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The deliverables licence is expressly “perpetual.”

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The deliverables licence is expressly “irrevocable.”

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The deliverables licence is expressly “worldwide.”

elements.element: The licence to deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The deliverables licence is expressly “royalty-free.”

elements.element: Customer may use the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly permits Client to “use” the deliverables.

elements.element: Customer may modify the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly permits Client to “modify” the deliverables.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly permits Client to “sublicense” the deliverables.

elements.element: Customer may exercise the licensed rights in the deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The licence expressly grants the listed rights “for its business.”

result.reason: The redline supplies most of the fallback deliverables licence, but it does not establish Vendor ownership of generic tools and know-how, so the fallback is incomplete. It also does not assign deliverables or work product, address embedded Vendor IP expressly, confirm Customer's retention of all Customer Data rights, or exclude joint ownership. The related Credit Data restriction and existing Interface ownership provision remain operative without directly contradicting the new licence, but the redline is not minimal because it fails to reach either complete position.
